doc: Per-tier simval gate thresholds (abgencompare/verdict.py). tier prod = abgen vs production asset-bundle-converter output (normalized comparison only; production CAB/GUIDs are nondeterministic by design). tier local = abgen vs the local abc-deterministic-guids converter (raw identity comparison gated). Allowlist entries only count when `why` is filled; every entry needs an evidence pointer (compat-bag discipline).

allowlist.why: The .resS texture stream size differs when ours preserves source texture dims/mips while the vintage production reference (v22-v36 era) applies a downsize cap and/or ships truncated mip chains. Same-vintage divergence reproduced 1:1 against the LIVE production CDN (12/12 label agreement snapshot-vs-live), so this is upstream vintage, not an adapter or abgen artifact.
allowlist.evidence: compat bag §A benign + mac-standalone decomposition ('dims: ours larger, upstream applies a downsize cap', 'upstream-ships-1-mip family')(abgen compat bag, 2026-07-03); runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac structure.jsonl (single divergent line class across all 18 structDiff pairs); live cross-check runs/20260715-154105-simval-a-live

allowlist.why: Dims policy: ours 1024x512 (source-preserving) vs upstream v36 512x256 (vintage downsize cap), mips 11 vs 10; decoded pixel compare impossible across dims, 0 delta otherwise.
allowlist.evidence: compat bag 'dims: ours larger, upstream applies a downsize cap ours doesn't' (abgen compat bag, 2026-07-03); texcmp rows in runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac

allowlist.why: Upstream-ships-1-mip vintage family: mips ours=10 vs upstream=1, base-level texels near-identical (maxChannelDelta 9, meanDelta 0.0023).
allowlist.evidence: compat bag 'upstream-ships-1-mip family ~745' + 'stale GLTFast-era build (runtime image_N textures, mips=1)... B-class (upstream vintage), do not chase'; texcmp rows in runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac

allowlist.why: BC7 encoder block-choice drift vs different-vintage upstream encoder: 17.8% of pixels differ but maxChannelDelta=4, meanDelta 0.14 — perceptually near-identical, over the 200ppm line only because the line counts pixels not magnitude.
allowlist.evidence: compat bag §A benign 'Honest-path BC7/mip per-pixel encoder drift vs different-vintage upstream (mean color + coverage match; e.g. m09764 stone texture 427K ppm but perceptually near-identical)'; texcmp rows in runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac

allowlist.why: BC7 encoder drift vs vintage upstream: 7.9% pixels differ, maxChannelDelta=16, meanDelta 0.047.
allowlist.evidence: compat bag §A benign BC7 encoder-drift class; texcmp rows in runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac

allowlist.why: Encoder/resize-semantics drift vs vintage upstream: 2.4% pixels differ, meanDelta 0.10, isolated edge texels to maxChannelDelta=88 (resize filter edge handling).
allowlist.evidence: compat bag 'encoder noise → resize-semantics divergence; worst offenders are content-scale/resize differences'; texcmp rows in runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac

allowlist.why: Encoder/resize-semantics drift vs vintage upstream: 0.6% pixels differ, meanDelta 0.089, isolated edge texels to maxChannelDelta=78.
allowlist.evidence: compat bag 'encoder noise → resize-semantics divergence'; texcmp rows in runs/20260715-153637-simval-a-win + 20260715-153654-simval-a-mac
